snippet.title: Ecrazeus Castle - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
#gamedev #indiegame #trailer 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4106270/Ecrazeus_Castle/

Follow me on X: https://x.com/MeringueRouge
Website: https://meringue-rouge.github.io/

My 3D action RPG game's store page is now online on Steam! If you can wishlist the game, I'd be most grateful! Think of it as a simplistic mix of Phantasy Star Online (or Diablo) with Kirby Air Ride's City Trial to some extent, but it is signficantly different to those games.

The game is expected to release sometime around 2026, but I'm aiming for it to be done and dusted by April. Progress is going very smoothly, and a Steam Next Fest demo is being worked on.
